title: Diamond Nautical

services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Boating tours are the perfect way to explore the beautiful waters of Murrells Inlet, SC, and Diamond Nautical is here to make your experience unforgettable. Our private boat tours cater to your needs, offering sunset cruises and day tours to historic Georgetown. One of our most popular tours is our Sunset Boat Cruises. Guests can choose from 60- or 90-minute options, both of which are private and limited to 6 people. Take in the stunning South Carolina sunset while enjoying the company of your loved ones or friends. For an even more luxurious experience, add on our food or beverage service, which includes non-alcoholic drinks. The marina where we depart from also has an on-site restaurant,
